description: This file provides utility functions for template string interpolation, variable extraction, and model name processing, specifically for response prefix templates in an auto-reply system.

methods.name: resolveResponsePrefixTemplate
methods.description: Interpolates variables within a response prefix template string using provided context.

methods.name: extractShortModelName
methods.description: Extracts a simplified short model name from a full model identifier string.

methods.name: hasTemplateVariables
methods.description: Checks if a template string contains any template variables.
